title: When Price Charts Rhyme: Historical Visual Retrieval for Stock Return Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.23723v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study whether visually similar price histories predict similar future returns, using a vision model to retrieve each stock's most similar charts from three decades of U.S. price histories. A representation pretrained only on natural images already retrieves neighbors whose realized returns predict the cross-section of stock returns. Aligning the representation with subsequent returns more than doubles the strategy's Sharpe ratio and outperforms a convolutional neural network trained directly on chart images. The predictability is concentrated among stocks with greater limits to arbitrage. Returns and order imbalances around portfolio formation indicate that the signal identifies temporary selling pressure that partially reverts. A sparse autoencoder traces the return-aligned signal to recurring visual states that determine which historical charts are retrieved. translated_title: 当价格图表押韵时：基于历史视觉检索的股票收益预测
translated_abstract: 我们研究视觉上相似的价格历史是否能预测相似的未来收益，利用视觉模型从三十年的美国股票价格历史中检索每只股票最相似的图表。仅在自然图像上预训练的表示已经能够检索出其已实现收益可预测股票收益横截面的相似历史图表。将表示与后续收益对齐后，策略的夏普比率翻了一倍以上，并且优于直接在图表图像上训练的卷积神经网络。这种可预测性集中在套利限制更大的股票中。投资组合构建前后的收益和订单失衡表明，该信号识别出会部分反转的暂时性卖压。稀疏自编码器将收益对齐的信号追溯至决定检索哪些历史图表的重复出现的视觉状态。我们的方法将每个预测追溯到带有具体日期的历史图表，使其更……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出用视觉模型从三十年历史行情中检索与当前图表视觉相似的历史价格走势来预测股票收益，将表示与后续收益对齐后夏普比率翻倍以上，且每个预测都可追溯到具体的历史图表，证明了“历史会押韵”在股市中的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper uses a vision model to retrieve visually similar historical price charts from three decades of U.S. market data for stock return prediction, showing that aligning the representation with subsequent returns more than doubles the Sharpe ratio while making each forecast traceable to specific dated historical charts.
